reviews.text: Very skilled and patient hairdresser! Helped me cut, bathe and blow dry my Shih Tzu who finds it a bit scary to get a haircut. Recommended!
Clipped our bichon frisee, very happy with clip and service

We tried Sergeis for the first time with our little sweet Havapoo. We loved the clip and it takes about 2.5 hours, so very easy to deal with. Parking right outside, the shop is inside the vet clinic.

He has experience and the price is also completely according to the market.
The dog is in the best hands and comes out feeling gentle and freshly groomed.
We are so happy with Sergei and have used him for many years😊 …

We have been to Sergei once and came across the salon after a recommendation via a schnauzer group on FB. Sergei was very thorough and quick in grooming and cutting my standard schnauzer 🖤 Professional, efficient and careful without a lot of fuss, we appreciate it! The fact that the process is short suits my dog ​​very well, as he is a well-behaved and harmless but somewhat nervous type. Sergei took the time to explain what he would do with grooming and care upon delivery 🐾
We will come back here next time!

Fast service, but my dog ​​has several wounds on her vulva after the clip last Friday, and is very uncomfortable and restless even 4 days later.
In addition, I was charged for a clip for a dog >5 kg, when my dog ​​weighs 4.8 kg.
____________________________________
I rarely publish reviews, and this section was added and changed 27/11-25
After I published the original review above, the dog groomer and owner of this business has threatened me both in response to the review, and via text message. He has tried to call me several times and I finally had to block his number. This weekend I was in contact with the vet when my bitch had a vulva that was very red and swollen, and looked more like some inflamed testicles.
I am surprised by all the positive reviews for this dog groomer, and wonder if it is because he threatens his customers if they criticize.
For the record, I googled this syndrome that he mentions is the cause of the wounds on my little Luna's vulva.
It clearly states that the symptoms are due to the groomer's negligence, hygiene conditions and equipment.
« Causes:
Overheating Clippers: Clippers that are too hot can cause burns.
Poor Maintenance: Clippers that are not regularly cleaned or lubricated may overheat.
Sensitive Skin: Dogs with sensitive skin may be more prone to clipper burns.
Prevention:
Regular Maintenance: Ensure that grooming clippers are regularly cleaned and lubricated.
Check Temperature: Keep clippers cool by pausing occasionally during grooming
Top service, good insight and understands the dog's needs. He takes his time with the customer and makes sure the dog is happy and healthy. 5 stars.

My Golden Retriever Bianca has been to Sergiy many times. He does a great job with her and she is so pretty afterwards, Bianca can be a bit stubborn and quirky, but Sergiy handles her perfectly. We are both super happy
Awesome, Sergei always delivers, very friendly!!!
Our two Bichon Havanese, Timmy and Theo, have been going to Sergei 5-6 times a year for the last 8-9 years. Sergei is without a doubt, Norway's very best dog groomer! 🏆👏 …
Sergei is a fantastic dog groomer who cares about the dog and always gives good advice. After we found him, we have never considered switching. Highly recommended!

I had made an appointment and given Sergei her breed (she is large and has a lot of fur) before ordering. I had spent time combing her so that there would be no tangles, and had taken time off work to deliver to the hairdresser. But when I arrived with the dog, he barely glanced at the dog and said he said he didn't cut dogs like that - and this despite the fact that we had been there the year before with a dog of the same breed and had given the breed when ordering. Incredibly unfriendly and arrogant guy with no respect for other people's time.
I would like to add that this happened a couple of years ago, and I have always meant to give a review, but better late than never

Sergei is an exceptional dog groomer who has consistently impressed me with his grooming skills. Sergei is also a kind and trustworthy person who can be highly recommended to anyone seeking first-class care for their furry friends.

We found Sergei by pure chance, and were met with a kindness and care (for both two and four-legged friends) that was very reassuring and trust-building. When the result was better than it has ever been (... and Tassen is 14 years old, with ditto experience..), the dog was obviously well taken care of and the price was acceptable in all respects...then we just have to thank him for a very well done job! Therefore; Thank you from both of us, Sergei...we will definitely be back in March 😊. Kind regards, Tassen and Thomas.

I would highly recommend this place. Sergei is passionate and very knowledgeable in this field. He takes his time and makes sure that the dog is comfortable throughout the process. Here you can be sure that he will not call it quits before …
